npc_id.description: the character's id: every round runs in the audience `member:<npc_id>`

phone.description: "1" offers the `phone_call` tool on every move; "" or "0" leaves the handset receive-only

world_start.description: RFC 3339 instant of day 1 in the world's clock; the start memories are dated `days_ago` before it

description.purpose: Adapts the world's lanes to the tool round: a move becomes a turn and its menu, the world's calls become one intent, a night becomes the close of the day and the dream.
description.not_in_scope: No model call, no memory of its own, no world knowledge.
description.emits_meaning: rim lanes with `hop.npc_rim` = out; the round's lanes inward.
description.consumes_meaning: the world's lanes, the dispatcher's expectation set, the round's answer, the memory's close report and interview bundles.
examples: obs -> in_menu + in_turn; calls -> in_calls (handoffs) + intent
